scopeStatement: Reviewed, enumerated outcome differential for RDF parsing, dataset topology, and round-trips, SPARQL query and update, SHACL Core and selected SHACL 1.2 additions, finite RDFS, and selected OWL 2 RL rules. This is not a claim of complete Apache Jena, W3C, SHACL, RDFS, or OWL conformance.
